_meta.source: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) Vulnerability Atlas of India & BMTPC Flood and Wind Hazard Maps
_meta.coverage_scope_note: Version 1.0.0 enumerates primary flood-prone alluvial basins (Brahmaputra, Ganga, Mahanadi, Godavari, Kosi, Yamuna) and high/very-high risk coastal cyclone districts (Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, Gujarat coastlines). Exhaustive national district coverage is scheduled for version 1.1.0.
